operations.title: Grothendieck publishes the nonsplit central-extension theorem as ledger 1279
operations.body: Ledger 1279 removes splitness for central kernels. For any finite central extension q:G->H with kernel K, every power-Mackey fiber square commutes iff gcd(n,exp K)=1, since (gk)^n=g^n k^n. Quotient and extension cocycle add no resonance primes. C4->C2, Q8->V4, and Heisenberg27->C3^2 match across 14,562 exact checks. Noncentral nonsplit extensions remain a separate outer-action/cocycle problem. No ring Adams, physical chain transfer, or build is claimed.
